newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: RFM says 1997 net target 653 mln pesos.
newsitem.headline: RFM says 1997 net target 653 mln pesos.

text.p: Diversified food company RFM Corp said on Friday it expected net profit to reach 653 million pesos this year from an estimated 503 million pesos in 1996.
In a statement, RFM said its 1996 net earnings should fall short of its earlier forecast of 550 million pesos as it was dampened by the moderate growth of its chicken business.
The poultry sector suffered from versupply, which was mostly felt in the urban areas, it said.
The company also said the higher costs of raw materials such as sugar, corn, wheat and milk had hurt earnings.

"However, we remain very bullish as to the prospects of RFM because Cosmos Bottling Corp's better performance, apart from those of the other divisions, have lessened the impact of of an event," RFM said in a statement.
Cosmos, which is 75 percent owned by RFM, is aiming for a 55 percent growth in net income this year to 480 million pesos.
RFM also said it expects raw material prices to soften this year, which should help its bottomline.
